explanation:
The target year for achieving the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) was 2015. While significant progress was made in many areas, some goals were not fully met.  

Since 2016, the world has shifted its focus to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), a more comprehensive set of 17 goals aimed at addressing global challenges such as poverty, inequality, climate change, and environmental degradation.

The SDGs build upon the progress made under the MDGs and set ambitious targets for the year 2030.
